name: The Setai Tel Aviv Hotel
positioning: Luxury hotel in a restored historic building in Old Jaffa, Tel Aviv, that preserves elements from the Ottoman and Crusader periods
best_for: Travelers who want a historic base in Old Jaffa near the beach, Jaffa Port and the flea market
Couples who want a spa with a Turkish hammam and dry sauna
Guests who enjoy dining and drinks in historic stone buildings

facts.text: The hotel is in Old Jaffa, near the beach, Clock Tower Square, Jaffa Port, the HaTachana compound and the flea market.
Preserved features of the building include large windows, ancient stone walls and arches.
The Kishle Bar is clad in blue Brazilian stone.
Kishle Bar serves an original cocktail menu and an extensive choice of Israeli wines.
Kishle Restaurant's dishes are made from fresh ingredients bought at local markets, with Mediterranean flavours.
Ocean Grill is a kosher restaurant on a terrace overlooking the coastline.
Guests in suites and Premium Plus rooms have access to the Mediterranean-style lounge, which has a lounge bar serving light meals.
Rooms have views of the sea, of Jaffa or of the hotel's patio.
Bathrooms are clad in marble and granite tiles.
The spa facilities include a Turkish hammam, a dry sauna, a pressure shower and a gym.
The Setai Tel Aviv is part of The Leading Hotels of the World.

highlights.text: The hotel's restored building is designed in a Mediterranean style that preserves original elements from the Ottoman and Crusader periods.
Kishle Bar is in an ancient stone building that was once used by the Ottoman authorities.
The spa is in a stone building in an area that once housed Old Jaffa's market.
Kishle Restaurant is set in a centuries-old Ottoman building and serves a la carte chef meals.
Rooms have Acqua di Parma bath products, exclusive to The Setai Tel Aviv.

considerations.text: The large outdoor pool operates from April, so it is seasonal.
Rooms look out over the sea, Jaffa or the hotel's patio, so not every room has a sea view.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
